main: Tired of bland oatmeal? This 3-minute savory miso oatmeal porridge is a game-changer! It's got that comforting umami flavor reminiscent of a Japanese breakfast, perfect for a quick, satisfying meal or a soothing hangover cure. Enjoy the fullness of a bowl of rice in just minutes.
reply1:
For 1 serving:
• 4 spoons oatmeal
• 250ml water
• ½ spoon miso paste (or Korean soybean paste)
• 1 egg
• A little chopped scallion & sesame seeds
reply2: Combine oatmeal, water, and miso in a large bowl. Microwave 1 minute 30 seconds, stir, then add and break the egg yolk. Microwave 1 more minute. Use a large bowl to prevent overflow.
alt_text: Savory miso oatmeal porridge in a ceramic bowl with soft egg swirled in, chopped scallions and sesame on top, steam rising, morning light on wooden table.
